digest.component_or_area: Pandoc verification pipeline / Gerrit Verify gate
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently executes complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every change, contributing a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound that should be moved off the per-change hot path.

The implementation must retain all existing corpus assertion classes, supported Python/OS matrix cells, behavioral/contractual assertions, and complete real-Pandoc replay capability without removing any.

Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs from corpus execution must replace broad assertion subprocess work in routine Verify, while three evidence-selected live product-path bodies per stratum (code_arrow, table, prose) remain in the gate.
An external pandoc-corpus-replay job must be added to run complete real-Pandoc replay of all 1,383 corpus conversions across ubuntu-latest and macos-latest on weekly and manual dispatch schedules.

Paired same-host A/B measurement shows 90.8% wall reduction (42s to 4s) in the focused Pandoc phase when switching from live replay to static lookup, validating the mechanism without dropping units or assertions.
